arguments.where_clause: transaction_type = 'Online Transaction' AND amount_usd_cents > 20000 AND card_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM cards c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Credit' AND u.credit_score < 650)
arguments.explanation: Flags online transactions over $200 made on credit cards whose cardholder has a credit score below 650.
assumptions: "Over $200" is read as strictly more than 20000 cents.
"Credit cards" means card_type = 'Credit' only, not debit or prepaid debit cards.
The card's owner is the user linked through cards.user_id.
